intro: Shoni the Shilent is an industrious gnome engineer stationed in Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. As commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew, she directs Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to salvage the power supply of a goblin shredder, fuel for the machines she hopes will break a path back into Gnomeregan.

p: Operating out of the smoky workshops of the Dwarven District, Shoni represents gnomish strategic ingenuity far from the lost halls of Gnomeregan. Her engineering plans are ambitious. With Gnomeregan in the hands of the troggs, Shoni is organizing an underground assault to retake it, and she sends operatives into the subterranean tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs.

Shoni's plan rests on the gnomes' own gyrodrillmatic excavationators, heavy drilling machines meant to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan and open the way for a gnomish assault. They lack the power to do it, so she wants the intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. Later, she also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan itself to tear apart its robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.
